title: taraxacum reichenbachii
intro: Taraxacum reichenbachii, commonly known as the Alpine Dandelion, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion genus, characterized by its bright yellow flowers and jagged leaves. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support liver and digestive health, and may also help to reduce inflammation and improve immune function. The therapeutic actions of Taraxacum reichenbachii include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hepatoprotective properties, which may contribute to its ability to protect the liver and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
